title: The VPN keeps timing out
picker_summary: Sales rep working from home can’t reach the CRM.

caller.name: Pedro
caller.mood: Frustrated. Can't update his deals without the CRM. Polite.
caller.opening_line: Hi, I’m working from home and the VPN won’t connect. It just spins and then gives up. I can’t get into the CRM.

verification_profile.calling_from: your own mobile, same number as the one on file
pressure_lines: I have deals to update before noon.
Is there anything I can do in the meantime?

hidden.cause: A problem with the company's VPN gateway, not Pedro's laptop or account. Other remote users are hitting the same timeout. L1 can't fix it; Network has to.

facts.fact: Working from home, VPN won't connect, needs the CRM.
The VPN app says 'The connection attempt timed out'.
It started this morning. It worked fine yesterday.
facts.reveal_when: asked when it started or whether it worked before

facts.fact: His home internet works. Websites and Outlook on the web load fine.
facts.reveal_when: asked whether his internet or other sites work

facts.fact: He already restarted the laptop and the router.
facts.reveal_when: asked what he's tried or whether he restarted
asked whether anything changed recently or about updates

facts.fact: He tried his phone's hotspot and got the same timeout.
facts.reveal_when: asked to try another network or a hotspot

facts.fact: Lucas messaged the team chat that his VPN isn't working either.
facts.reveal_when: asked whether anyone else has the problem

facts.fact: If he quits and reopens the VPN app or reconnects, it still times out the same way.
facts.reveal_when: the technician asks him to reconnect, reopen the VPN app, or restart it

facts.fact: If he restarts the laptop again, the VPN still times out.
facts.reveal_when: the technician asks him to restart again

account: Successful this morning from his home network (Microsoft 365 web)

solution.diagnosis: Company-side VPN problem: timeouts on two networks, internet fine, credentials fine, other users affected. Do the L1 checks, then escalate to Network with the details.

escalate_network.caller_reaction: He's told Network has it. He asks roughly how long it'll take.

admin_password_reset.why: The error is a timeout, not a sign-in failure, and his sign-ins are fine.
admin_password_reset.caller_reaction: He has to change his password. The VPN still times out.

require_mfa_reregistration.why: MFA has nothing to do with a VPN timeout.
require_mfa_reregistration.caller_reaction: He has to set up his authenticator again. The VPN still times out.

escalate_security.why: Nothing points to a security incident. Wrong team.
escalate_security.caller_reaction: He's told someone will look at it.

solution.on_unlisted_action: Nothing changes. The VPN still times out.

diagnosis.check: Gets the exact error and when it started
Confirms his internet works and only the VPN fails
Finds out whether others are affected, which points to the company side
Rules out his account from the lookup or by asking, instead of resetting the password

verification.check: Completes basic L1 checks, such as a restart, another network, and the client error, before escalating
Doesn't escalate to the wrong team or make account changes that can't help

communication.check: Explains in plain words that it looks like a company-side problem, not his laptop
Sets expectations: Network has it, a rough timeline, and how he'll hear back
Offers a workaround for urgent work, like web apps that don't need the VPN

documentation.check: Notes record the error message and when it started
Notes list the L1 checks done and that other users are affected
